basic_details.job_title: CSIR IMMT Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 41 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research - Institute of Minerals and Materials Technology (CSIR-IMMT) Apprentice Trainee Notification 2026 has been released on 05 August 2026 on the official website immt.res.in. A total of 41 (tentative) Apprentice Trainee vacancies have been announced through the CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026.

how_to_apply: This recruitment does not use an online application form. Instead, eligible candidates must follow the walk-in process below:
Register on NATS 2.0 (Diploma/Graduate candidates) or NAPS (ITI candidates) portal, if not already registered.
Send a confirmation email of participation to [email protected] by 11:00 AM on 17.08.2026.
Download and fill the Application Form (Annexure-I) provided with the notification.
Report to S.S. Bhatnagar Hall, CSIR-IMMT, Bhubaneswar between 9:30 AM and 10:15 AM on 18.08.2026 for registration and document verification.

Carry the filled application form along with self-attested photocopies of: 10th mark sheet and certificate; +2/Diploma/Degree mark sheet and certificate; Aadhaar card; Caste/Disability certificate (if applicable); and Bank passbook copy.
Attend the walk-in interview scheduled at 10:30 AM on 18.08.2026.
Candidates arriving after the 10:15 AM reporting cut-off will not be permitted to appear for the interview.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should note that no one will be allowed to appear for the interview after the reporting time closes at 10:15 AM.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Vacancy 2026: Category-wise Vacancy and Stipend
content_sections.text: CSIR-IMMT Bhubaneswar plans to engage 41 apprentice trainees across Engineering Graduate, Non-Engineering Graduate, Diploma Engineering and ITI categories. The institute has clarified that these numbers are tentative and may change. As per the notification, 50% of the stipend is paid by CSIR-IMMT on a monthly basis, and the remaining 50% government share (Rs. 4,500/- for Graduate-level trainees and Rs. 4,000/- for Diploma-level trainees) is paid at the old rate as per BOPT Letter No. BOPT/DT/2025-26 dated 15.09.2025. The notification does not specify a separate government-share breakdown for ITI trainees.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility depends on the category applied for. All candidates must have completed their qualifying exam within the last five years and must not have prior work experience of one year or more, and must not have previously undergone apprenticeship training elsewhere. Before appearing for the interview, candidates must register on the applicable government apprenticeship portal: Diploma / Engineering Graduate / Non-Engineering Graduate candidates: NATS 2.0 Portal (nats.education.gov.in) ITI candidates: NAPS Portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) Registration must be completed within five years of passing the qualifying examination, and only candidates who have registered and meet the eligibility criteria will be considered for the walk-in interview.

rows.minimum_qualification: Regular full-time Degree in Engineering/Technology in the relevant discipline from a recognized/approved University or Institution, completed within the last five years.
Regular full-time three-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology in the relevant discipline from a recognized/approved University or Institution, completed within the last five years.
Graduation passed from any Government-recognized Board/University, completed within the last five years.
ITI qualification in the relevant trade from any Government-recognized Board/University.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: Apprentice trainees will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 9,600/- to Rs. 12,300/-, depending on the category and trade, as detailed in the vacancy table above. 50% of the amount is paid by CSIR-IMMT and 50% is the government share.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based entirely on the candidate's performance in the walk-in interview held at CSIR-IMMT, Bhubaneswar. There is no written exam mentioned in the notification. Candidates selected will receive an engagement letter by email and must submit their acceptance within 3 days and join within 7 days of receiving it, failing which the selection is treated as cancelled.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This recruitment does not use an online application form. Instead, eligible candidates must follow the walk-in process below: Register on NATS 2.0 (Diploma/Graduate candidates) or NAPS (ITI candidates) portal, if not already registered. Send a confirmation email of participation to [email protected] by 11:00 AM on 17.08.2026. Download and fill the Application Form (Annexure-I) provided with the notification. Report to S.S. Bhatnagar Hall, CSIR-IMMT, Bhubaneswar between 9:30 AM and 10:15 AM on 18.08.2026 for registration and document verification. Carry the filled application form along with self-attested photocopies of: 10th mark sheet and certificate; +2/Diploma/Degree mark sheet and certificate; Aadhaar card; Caste/Disability certificate (if applicable); and Bank passbook copy. Attend the walk-in interview scheduled at 10:30 AM on 18.08.2026. Candidates arriving after the 10:15 AM reporting cut-off will not be permitted to appear for the interview.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee: General Conditions
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed their diploma/graduation within the last five years and must not have completed five years since passing the qualifying exam. Candidates should not hold one year or more of prior work experience and must not have undergone apprenticeship training elsewhere previously. Original College Leaving Certificate (CLC) must be submitted at the time of joining and will be retained during the apprenticeship tenure. All original educational and identity documents will be verified at the time of reporting. The engagement is purely temporary for one year and does not entitle the apprentice to a claim for regular employment at CSIR-IMMT. Selected candidates must arrange their own accommodation; hostel accommodation may be provided subject to availability. The decision of the Competent Authority, CSIR-IMMT, on all matters relating to eligibility, selection, and cancellation is final and binding. Candidates from an Engineering or Diploma background can also explore more Engineering Apprentice Jobs and Diploma Apprentice Jobs available across India. ITI-qualified candidates looking for similar openings can check the latest ITI Apprentice Jobs. Candidates based in or near Odisha can browse more Odisha Government Jobs and Bhubaneswar Government Jobs . Those interested in research-institute careers can also explore ongoing CSIR Recruitment 2026 notifications across various CSIR labs.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in recruitment drive by CSIR-Institute of Minerals and Materials Technology, Bhubaneswar, to engage students as Apprentice Trainees for a one-year period under the Apprenticeship Act, 2025, across Engineering Graduate, Non-Engineering Graduate, Diploma, and ITI categories.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 41 vacancies are available across all categories, though the institute has stated the numbers are tentative and may change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application. Interested candidates must send a confirmation email by 11:00 AM on 17.08.2026 and appear for the walk-in interview on 18.08.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification depends on the category: an Engineering degree, a Diploma in Engineering, a graduation in BA/B.Sc/B.Com/BCA, or an ITI certificate, each completed within the last five years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for CSIR-IMMT Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register on the NATS 2.0 or NAPS portal, send a confirmation email by the deadline, and appear in person for the walk-in interview with the filled application form and required documents.
